profile.text: Aroma Rinaldi is from a Columbian family that runs a workshop making and selling pristine fragrances. She currently receives Oripathy treatment at Rhodes Island, and has signed a cooperation agreement with our Logistics Department. At present, she is in charge of daily cleaning duties aboard the landship, as well as logistical support for field operations such as resupplying and disaster relief.
